definitions.explanation: The room in a school where teachers have their desks and work between classes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{職員室|しょくいんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher is in the staff room.

examples.japanese: {職員室|しょくいんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: I was called to the staff room.

examples.japanese: {職員室|しょくいんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っていて→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧。
examples.english: Please wait in front of the staff room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{職員室|しょくいんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: The teacher is in the staff room.

examples.japanese: {職員室|しょくいんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I was waiting for the teacher in front of the staff room.

notes:
{職員室|しょくいんしつ} is the shared room in a Japanese school where all teachers have their desks and do their work between classes. Unlike many Western schools, Japanese teachers typically do not have individual offices.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧ (staff) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {職員室|しょくいんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be in the staff room
- {職員室|しょくいんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to be called to the staff room (often implies being in trouble)
- {職員室|しょくいんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait in front of the staff room

CULTURAL NOTE:
Students who need to speak with a teacher typically go to the {職員室|しょくいんしつ} and knock before entering. Being "called to the staff room" ({職員室|しょくいんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧) often implies a reprimand.
